scripts.build: tsc && npm run build:extension && npm run build:acp
scripts.build:extension: esbuild src/extension.mts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --log-level=warning --external:@github/copilot-sdk --banner:js='// Built from src/extension.mts by npm run build.' --outfile=copilot-min/extensions/minprompt/extension.mjs
scripts.build:acp: esbuild src/acp.mts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --log-level=warning --banner:js='// Built from src/acp.mts by npm run build. Bundles @agentclientprotocol/sdk and zod.' --outfile=copilot-min/acp/adapter.mjs
